macros.name: attrib
macros.doc: \attrib will place the attribution flush right to the margins of the block.

macros.name: attribcitations
macros.doc: Sets up citations for within an attrib-like environment.

macros.name: AttribInit
macros.doc: \AttribInit is an hook, empty by default, that gets executed after some standard setup but before the core of the \attrib macro.

macros.name: AttribMinSkip
macros.doc: \AttribMinSkip is a length, the minimum amount of horizontal space that must come after any previous text and before the attribution.

macros.name: normalcitations
macros.doc: Whenever within an attribution you want the normal behavior of citations back, write \normalcitations.
